blurb: Flow Yoga Center offers a variety of yoga and Pilates classes including infrared heated vinyasa, candlelight flow, yin yoga with crystal bowl sound baths, and power sculpt. Classes are held in person at Logan Circle studios, seasonally at the National Cathedral, and online via livestream and video library. The studio provides a welcoming space with free mats, towels, and post-class aromatherapy.
